comboData.title: X-Cross Cannon into Union Controller - Triple Extra Deck Finish
comboData.description: A second X-Cross Cannon opening that trades it away with B-Buster Drake to Link Summon Platinum Gadget, then banishes Y-Yare Head and Platinum Gadget as Fusion Material for Union Controller. Union Controller and Union Hangar chain into A-Assault Core and C-Crush Wyvern, bridging through Silhouhatte Rabbit into a Tellarknight Ptolemaeus built from A-Assault Core, Z-Zillion Tank, and Y-Yare Head. Ptolemaeus is Xyz Changed up into Cyber Dragon Nova and then Cyber Dragon Infinity, while the spent Graveyard pieces are banished to pay for both Fusion Summons - ABC-Dragon Buster and XYZ-Hyper Dragon Cannon - for a three-card Extra Deck board plus a set Angel Statue - Azurune.

comboData.title: Alien FTK: Premature Burial Loop into Machu Mech and Dark Strike Fighter
comboData.description: A three-card first-turn kill. Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar returns your face-up Spells to your hand and places an A-Counter for each one, so Premature Burial revives Gol'gar over and over while Code A Ancient Ruins spends the counters to bring Alien Ammonite back. Each revival opens a new Synchro or Link Summon: Nothung burns 800, Worldsea Dragon Zealantis resets every monster, and Geonator Transverser gives your opponent Ancient Sacred Wyvern. The 7200 LP you spend on Burials pumps that Wyvern to 8500 ATK under their control, and Number 33: Chronomaly Machu Mech burns them for the 6400 difference. Dark Strike Fighter Tributes itself for the last 1400. Your opponent never gets a turn. Starting hand: Alien Ammonite + Unexpected Dai + Premature Burial. Deck: Alien Shocktrooper, Code A Ancient Ruins, Black Garden. Extra Deck: Gol'gar, M-Frame, Zer'oll, Nothung, Ancient Sacred Wyvern, Zealantis, Garden Rose Maiden, Geonator Transverser, Saryuja Skull Dread, Muddy Mudragon, Dark Strike Fighter, Machu Mech. A hand trap that stops Gol'gar or Premature Burial ends the loop, and you finish on 800 LP.

comboData.title: Theorealized Medius: Nerva, Diactorus and an Impasto Hand-off
comboData.description: Going first with an Artmage build. Artmage Power Patron is the Power Patron card that lets Theorealized Medius Special Summon itself from the hand, and the Theorealize Liberation it adds calls Nervedo for Nerva. You pass with Nerva, Artmage Diactorus, Artmage Graflare and Theorealized Medius (Illusion, Fairy and Dragon: three Monster Types) plus a set Artmage Impasto -Recapture-. On your opponent's turn, Impasto banishes Artmage Diactorus face-up until the End Phase. That banish triggers Theorealized Medius, which brings out a second Artmage Diactorus while the first is away. Starting hand: Medius the Pure + Theorealized Medius. Extra Deck: Nerva the Power Patron of Creation and 2 Artmage Diactorus.

comboData.description: Going second with the Ars Magna package. Theorealized Medius skips the first Ars Magna banish and waits for the second, once Ars Magna "Citrinitas" is face-up. Citrinitas is always treated as a DoomZ card, which gives the DoomZ Break - Diactorus it calls from the Extra Deck a DoomZ card to destroy before it destroys a monster. That summon also brings back the Corruption and the Purification, and the Purification Power Patron Link Summon returns the Division and the Union. comboData.title: Theorealized Medius: Theorealize, a Self-Banish and Past Lull
comboData.description: A Medius build with two copies of Theorealized Medius and no Artmage cards in the Main Deck. Medius the Pure calls one copy from the Deck, and that copy is the Power Patron card the one in your hand needs. Theorealize sends a second Medius the Pure to the GY. That copy revives itself and is banished when it leaves the field, and the face-up banish triggers Theorealized Medius. The same Link Summon puts the other copy in the GY, which is what Purification Power Patron's search needs. You end on Purification Power Patron, Artmage Diactorus and a Medius the Pure your opponent couldn't respond to. Starting hand: Medius the Pure + Theorealized Medius.

steps.text: Normal Summon Medius the Pure.
Activate effect: Medius the Pure was Normal Summoned.
Special Summon a second Theorealized Medius from your Deck. It is always treated as a Power Patron card.
Activate effect: Theorealized Medius in your hand. The copy on the field is a Power Patron card, and no copy has used this effect this turn.
Special Summon Theorealized Medius from your hand.
Add Theorealize from your Deck to your hand. Its name makes it a Theorealize Spell.
Activate Theorealize.
Send a second Medius the Pure from your Deck to the GY as the cost.
Theorealize resolves: look at the top card of your opponent's Deck and put it on the top or the bottom. Theorealize goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Medius the Pure in your GY. The first copy only used its summon effect, so this effect is still free.
Shuffle the first Medius the Pure from the field into your Deck. Past Lull will summon it again at the end.
Special Summon Medius the Pure from your GY. It will be banished when it leaves the field.
Send the Theorealized Medius that came from the Deck to the GY as material.
Use Medius the Pure as material too. It was summoned by its own effect, so it's banished face-up instead of going to the GY.
Link Summon Purification Power Patron to the left Extra Monster Zone.
Activate effect: Purification Power Patron's summon trigger. The Theorealized Medius in your GY is a Power Patron monster.
In the same chain, activate effect: the Theorealized Medius still on the field. Medius the Pure was just banished face-up.
Theorealized Medius resolves first: banish it.
Special Summon Artmage Diactorus from your Extra Deck, into the zone below Purification Power Patron.
Purification Power Patron resolves: add Theorealize Past Lull from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Theorealize Past Lull. Artmage Diactorus is an Artmage card, so its condition is met.
Theorealize Past Lull resolves: Special Summon Medius the Pure from your Deck. Your opponent can't respond to the summon. Its summon effect was already used this turn.
Theorealize Past Lull goes to the GY.

End board: Purification Power Patron, Artmage Diactorus and Medius the Pure. Medius is the other DARK Fairy that keeps Purification's Quick Effect live on your opponent's turn, and Past Lull's GY effect is ready for next turn.

comboData.title: A Modern First Turn: Swordsoul, Step by Step
comboData.description: A real modern first turn, with every step labelled with the word players use for it. Two cards in hand, Swordsoul of Mo Ye and Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan, become two Synchro Monsters that can stop up to three of your opponent's plays, and Ash Blossom stays in your hand. Every card here can be played at three copies in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026).

steps.text: STARTER · Normal Summon Swordsoul of Mo Ye. That uses your one Normal Summon for the turn.

CHOKE POINT · Activate effect: Mo Ye was Normal Summoned, so you reveal Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan from your hand to Special Summon a Swordsoul Token. Revealing is the cost, and Longyuan stays in your hand. If your opponent negates Mo Ye right now with Effect Veiler or Infinite Impermanence, there is no Token and the combo stops. Ash Blossom can't stop it, because the Token doesn't come from the Deck.
TOKEN · A Swordsoul Token, a Level 4 Tuner, is Special Summoned. LOCK: while it's on the field, Synchro Monsters are the only monsters you can Special Summon from your Extra Deck.
MATERIAL · The Swordsoul Token is used as Synchro Material. Tokens never reach the GY; they simply vanish.
MATERIAL · Swordsoul of Mo Ye goes to the GY as the other Synchro Material. Level 4 + Level 4 = 8.
Synchro Summon Swordsoul Grandmaster - Chixiao, a Level 8 Synchro Monster. Synchro Monsters can go straight into a Main Monster Zone.

CHAIN · Activate effects: Chixiao's Summon and Mo Ye going to the GY as Synchro Material trigger at the same time, so both go on one chain. You pick the order: Chixiao's search is Chain Link 1 and Mo Ye's draw is Chain Link 2, so the draw resolves first.
DRAW · Chain Link 2 resolves: Mo Ye draws you 1 card. That's a free card, a +1.
SEARCH · Chain Link 1 resolves: Chixiao adds Swordsoul of Taia from your Deck to your hand. Chixiao gets one effect per turn: this search now, and its negate on your opponent's turn.
COST · Discard Swordsoul of Taia to activate Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan's effect in your hand. Its cost is discarding another Swordsoul card, and that's why Chixiao searched one.
EXTENDER · Longyuan Special Summons itself from your hand. It couldn't start this combo alone, but it keeps it going after your first Synchro.
TOKEN · Longyuan then Special Summons another Swordsoul Token, a Level 4 Tuner, with the same lock.
MATERIAL · The second Swordsoul Token vanishes as Synchro Material.
MATERIAL · Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan goes to the GY as Synchro Material. Level 6 + Level 4 = 10.
Synchro Summon Swordsoul Sinister Sovereign - Qixing Longyuan, a Level 10 Synchro Monster.
BURN · Activate effect: Longyuan was sent to the GY as Synchro Material, so your opponent takes 1200 damage. Their Life Points drop from 8000 to 6800.

END BOARD · You end your turn with two Synchro Monsters. On your opponent's turn, Chixiao can negate a monster's effects by banishing Swordsoul of Taia from your GY, and Qixing Longyuan can banish one monster they Special Summon and one Spell or Trap card they activate, with 1200 damage each time. That's up to three interruptions, and Ash Blossom is still in your hand as your handtrap.

comboData.title: Black Whirlwind Chain into a Six-Monster Synchro Board
comboData.description: A Black Whirlwind-powered opening that chains Simoon the Poison Wind, Sudri the Phantom Glimmer, and Vata the Emblem of Wandering into a repeating Synchro engine. Nothung the Starlight and Boreastorm the Wicked Wind are Synchro Summoned and sent back to the Graveyard in sequence, using Black Feather Whirlwind and Zephyros the Elite to keep re-fueling the Whirlwind loop and pump out three separate copies of Black-Winged Assault Dragon. The line closes with Blackwing Full Armor Master, a second Black-Winged Dragon, and a second Nothung the Starlight rounding out a six-monster board, backed by Twin Shadow and Black Shadow Squall set in the Spell/Trap Zone. Heads-up: this line uses Crossout Designator, which is Forbidden in the TCG, so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.title: Simoon and Sudri Double Summon into Bystial Dis Pater
comboData.description: A Black Whirlwind opening that converts Simoon the Poison Wind and Sudri the Phantom Glimmer into two Normal Summons in the same turn. Simoon banishes Harmattan the Dust from hand to summon itself, Whirlwind searches off every summon, and Shamal the Sandstorm banishes itself to bring out Vata the Emblem of Wandering, which mills Chinook the Snow Blast and Zephyros the Elite for Black-Winged Dragon. Zephyros bounces Sudri back to hand to reuse it, Black-Winged Dragon is recycled into Bystial Dis Pater, and Black Feather Whirlwind revives Zephyros and Sharnga the Waning Moon to Synchro Summon Blackwing - Nothung the Starlight. The board finishes with Dis Pater, Nothung, a re-summoned Sudri and Blackwing - Twin Shadow active in the backrow.

The setup cascades into summoning three separate copies of Black-Winged Assault Dragon, before Blackwing - Twin Shadow recycles materials into Blackwing Full Armor Master and adds Chinook the Snow Blast to hand for quick-effect monster negation.

comboData.title: Deep-Abyss Dual Floodgate Full Combo
comboData.description: An advanced full-combo Blue-Eyes line opening with Deep-Eyes White Dragon, the Blue Abyss and Maiden of White. The line searches Sage with Eyes of Blue and deploys True Light, Wishes for Eyes of Blue, and Mausoleum of White to mill Blue-Eyes White Dragon and revive Deep-Eyes from the Graveyard. Leveraging Kewl Tune Rotary into Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon, it bridges through Crystron Halqifibrax Prism and Rciela into Dragunity Lord - Georgius equipped with Dragunity Knight - Luin (locking opponent Graveyard effects). Elemental Saga Doriado extends the board into Borreload Savage Dragon and Zalen the Shackled Dragon, ending on an oppressive multi-negate board backed by two Graveyard floodgates, Majesty of the White Dragons, and Infinite Impermanence.

comboData.title: Pumpking's Eldlich Splash into The Undying Legion
comboData.description:
A one-card Pumpking opening that snowballs into the deck's full Eldlich package. Pumpking discards itself as the reveal cost to Set Call of the Haunted, then the Trap revives it immediately, netting Changshi the Spiridao from the Deck and milling Army of the Haunted and Eldlich the Golden Lord along the way.

Overlaying Pumpking and Changshi into Officiator of Doom Samuel restocks Changshi from the Graveyard, which lets Army of the Haunted Special Summon itself off its own trigger — fueling a Rank-Up into Pumpking the Great Ghost King. Ghost King's on-field effects mill Stare of the Snake Hair and bounce Delta of Invitation back to hand.

Eldlich the Golden Lord revives itself by sending a Call of the Haunted to the Graveyard as cost, then tributes itself to Fusion Summon Fallen Angel of the Golden Land. Call of the Forgotten Sets two more copies of Call of the Haunted from the Deck before the turn closes on an Xyz Summon of The Undying Legion — leaving a Fusion monster, a Rank 7 boss, a live Field Spell, and a fresh trap line all in play.

comboData.title: Fiendsmith Engraver One-Card: Zero King Machinex into Zeus Ragnarok and Deus Machinex
comboData.description: A one-card line from Fiendsmith Engraver. The Fiendsmith engine makes Fiendsmith's Lacrima and D/D/D Wave High King Caesar, which searches Dark Contract with the Gate when it leaves the field. From there the D/D half takes over: Zero Doom Queen Machinex places Dark Contract with the Zero King, Solomon and Marksman King Tell build Abyss King Gilgamesh, and Necro Slime and Alfred make Flame King Genghis. Orthros destroys the Zero King to bring Machinex back from the Extra Deck, and Zeus Ragnarok gives you a second Pendulum Summon. End board: Zeus Ragnarok, Deviser King Deus Machinex, Wave High King Caesar with 2 materials and Cursed King Siegfried, with Count Surveyor and Savant Thomas as Pendulum Scales, Dark Contract with the Gate, and a Set Dark Contract with the Eternal Darkness. TCG note: the line runs through Spright Elf, which is Forbidden in the TCG, and uses the one copy of Fiendsmith's Lacrima that the Limited list allows. Starting hand: Fiendsmith Engraver.

Rod searches Dark Magical Curtain, Curtain brings out Dark Magician and adds Soul Servant, and that Dark Magician becomes Dark Magician of Destruction, which searches Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant. Sleepy Scapegoats brings Tokens and Swiftwind Panther Warrior, Panther Tributes a Token for Jinzo - Energy Shocker, which destroys your opponent's Traps while its lock stops them chaining new ones. Alligator's Dragon Knight adds Graceful & Skull Dice and Foolish Graverobber. Then Dark Time Wizard's coin toss. comboData.title: Doom-Z Full Combo Line
comboData.description: Going first from DoomZ V Five - Amalthe and Mulcharmy Fuwalos, transcribed move by move from a recorded duel. Amalthe finds Drastea, and Drastea climbs through DoomZ XII End - Drastrius into DoomZ XIII Over - Graflareio. Raiders and Graflareio's floating effect bring out Elara, DoomZ Change and Jupredo, and A.D.R.A.S.T.E.I.A. sends Jupredo face-up to the Extra Deck for Terminus. Elara and Amalthe become Springans Merrymaker and then Gigantic "Champion" Sargas, which adds Therion "King" Regulus. Terminus, Vidolium and Vidolia bring out Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction, and DoomZ Change and DoomZ Destruction finish the board. You pass with Sargas, Regulus, Jupiter, a Drastea holding D.O.O.M.D.U.R.G. and Jupredo, DoomZ Raiders and Vidolia face-up, DoomZ Destruction Set and A.D.R.A.S.T.E.I.A. in hand.

comboData.title: The Rotation: Line 1's Board on Your Opponent's Turn
comboData.description: What the Line 1 board does once your opponent starts playing. Rhapsodia revives Tinia and negates a card while June Pride is still there to count as your Synchro Monster. Then June Pride returns to the Extra Deck for one Elfnote each from your GY and Deck. Regina lands in the center zone and, with its once-per-turn effects reset, calls one more. Tinia, Lucina and Fortuna then take turns switching into the center zone: each switch fires that monster's Quick Effect. That is four disruptions from a one-card combo. Needs a second Elfnote Lucina in the Deck (legal at 3 in the TCG). Start: June Pride in the center zone, Welcome Home face-up, Rhapsodia Set, Regina in hand.

comboData.title: Going Second: Junora's Negate into a 9900 ATK Swing
comboData.description: Going second into a set-up board, with no Elfnote Power Patron and no Welcome Home, so the Extra Deck stays open for Link Monsters. Regina calls Junoldo from the Deck, and Junoldo turns into Junora. Junora counts as Synchro Summoned, so it negates every face-up card your opponent controls. Medius the Pure calls Theorealized Medius for Purification Power Patron, and Overdrive brings Medius back for Mediclius. Medius's own GY effect fills the last zone, so Mediclius points at three monsters: it is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects, and its Main Phase effect negates their monsters and halves their ATK. Skip June Pride here: in the center zone it stops your side monsters from attacking. Starting hand: Elfnote Lucina + Medius the Pure + 3 non-engine cards.

comboData.title: Endymion Full Combo Line (Advanced)
comboData.description: Advanced full combo line weaving together the Magistus, Spellbook, Witchcrafter, Sky Striker, and Mythical Beast engines. Not recommended for beginners — requires precise sequencing across 200+ steps. This is a specific draw loop variant of the deck, distinct from the standard Endymion line (which ends on multiple negates via Servant → Electrumite → Selene). The core of the draw loop: Royal Magical Library accumulates spell counters from each spell activation and cashes them in for free draws, while Wonder Wand draws 2 by sending itself and its equipped monster to the GY, and Pot of Avarice recycles monsters back into the deck for another two draws — each cycle fuelling the next until you have enough resources to establish the full end board with multiple Endymion bounce negates and set backrow.

comboData.description: A one-card line from Speedroid Terrortop, with one more card to discard to Flavian. Terrortop and Taketomborg make M-X-Saber Invoker, which brings Gladiator Beast Attorix from the Deck. comboData.title: Dragonfly-Centipede Loop into a Triple Xyz End Board
comboData.description: A Dragonfly-opened line that leans on the repeatable Inzektor Ladybug equip-and-send loop to keep re-triggering Inzektor Dragonfly and Inzektor Centipede's non-once-per-turn effects. Each equip cycle chains into another Special Summon or search, snowballing through Zektrike Kou-ou and Inzektor Hornet to refill the hand and Graveyard. The line closes on a three-monster board of Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy, Number 90: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Lord, and Number 3: Cicada King, with Inzektor Sword - Zektkaliber left in the Graveyard for follow-up.

comboData.title: Endymion Magistus into the Full Fairy Tail Package
comboData.description: A hybrid line that builds the Magistus core off Spell Power Mastery before pivoting into a complete Fairy Tail package. Spell Power Mastery opens Regulus, the Prince of Endymion, which lands Endymion Empire and Verre, the Maid of Endymion; Verre Magic - Lacrima of Light and Witchcrafter Genni fuel Zoroa, the Magistus of Flame. Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden becomes Borreload Savage Dragon, then Spenta and Endymion, the Crescent Magistus feed Magistus Chorozo, Summon Sorceress and Akashic Magician, closing the Magistus half on Zoroa, the Magistus Verethragna. From there Fairy Tail - Luna and Matchgiru make Fairy Tail - Wiccat under Fairy Tail Ball, loading Once Upon a Fairy Tail and Tails of the Fairy Tails for Teller of Fairy Tails, a revived Fairy Tail - Snow and a second Wiccat, with Snow banishing the spent Magistus pieces to reset Once Upon a Fairy Tail. Heads-up: this line uses Borreload Savage Dragon, which is Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.title: Twin Dragon Loop into Herald of Mirage Lights
comboData.description:
Continuing the Angwitch opening: Mace revives itself from the Graveyard, mills again, and fuels a second Mementotlan Fusion — bringing back Mementomictlan Tecuhtlica – Creation King straight out of the GY.

Tecuhtlica's on-summon mill revives Ghattic (who retrieves Shleepy) and banishes itself to activate the Mementomictlan field spell. Shleepy then special summons itself and fuels a second Fusion into Mementotlan Twin Dragon.

Twin Dragon's own Graveyard trigger sets the field spell off a second time, reviving Goblin, Akihiron, and Shleepy and chaining through a banished Fusion and Goblin's revival effects.

The line closes by Link Summoning Herald of Mirage Lights, reviving Mementotlan-Horned Dragon and Mementoal Tecuhtlica – Combined Creation from the Graveyard, and setting Bone Party, Fusion, and Cranium Burst as backrow for next turn.

comboData.title: Memento into Fiendsmith Splash — Necroquip Princess, Ptolemy M7 & Double Desirae
comboData.description:
Same Angwitch-into-Twin Dragon Memento core, splashed into a full Fiendsmith package. After the Mementomictlan field spell revives Goblin, Akihiron, and Shleepy, Link Summon Moon of the Closed Heaven into Fiendsmith's Requiem, then tribute Requiem to Special Summon Lacrima the Crimson Tears and mill a Fiendsmith Engraver.

Requiem's Graveyard effect fuels a Fusion Summon of Necroquip Princess. The Engraver chain keeps going into an Xyz Summon of Constellar Ptolemy M7, a Fiendsmith's Tract that searches Fabled Lurrie, and a Link Summon of Fiendsmith's Sequence that Fusion Summons Fiendsmith's Desirae.

Sequence and Desirae are sent together to Link Summon Cross-Sheep alongside a revived Mementoal Tecuhtlica – Combined Creation. Cross-Sheep chains into Lacrima once more to Link Summon A Bao A Qu, the Lightless Shadow.

A Bao A Qu mills Bone Party and banishes itself to Fusion Summon a second Fiendsmith's Desirae. The turn ends with Fusion and Cranium Burst set, plus an active Mementomictlan field spell, for a commanding board-and-backrow presence. Heads-up: this line uses Moon of the Closed Heaven, which is Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.title: Masquerade V Rank-Up Chain: Gorgonic to Chaos Barian Dragon
comboData.description: Going first from Gorgonic Umbral Horror alone. Number 104: Masquerade V needs three Level 4 monsters, but Gorgonic counts as two of them. From there the line climbs Rank 4 to Rank 5 to Rank 7 without a Rank-Up-Magic Spell. Every step is an Xyz Summon that keeps its materials, and C104 Victory picks up Masquerade V's banish effect on the way. Nibiru is live once C104 Victory lands, since it is the fifth summon. The Barian's guide covers the longer Barian's Seventh Untopia version. Starting hand: Gorgonic Umbral Horror.

Xyz Summon CXyz Hope Chaos Barian Dragon using only Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory. Gorgonic is material rather than a face-up monster, so its restriction does not apply.
C104 Victory becomes material for the Dragon.
Masquerade V transfers along with C104 Victory. The Dragon does not inherit Masquerade V's effect.

Gorgonic Umbral Horror transfers too, so the Dragon holds 3 cards: C104 Victory, Masquerade V and Gorgonic. That is 3000 ATK, and a Number C is attached, so your opponent can no longer add cards from their Main Deck to their hand except by drawing.

Set Barian's Seal. With the Dragon on the field, it negates your opponent's first Spell, Trap or monster effect next turn, then lets you attach a monster to one of your Xyz Monsters. End board: the Dragon with 4 materials, Shining Umbral Horror, a set Barian's Seal, and the card Shining drew.

comboData.title: Daredevil: Two-Card Triantis Backrow Break
comboData.description: Going second into a boss that can't be targeted, a second monster and two Set cards. Ophrys Scorpio and Byblisp find Bufolicula and Triantis. Triantis places Predator Counters by choosing, not targeting, so the boss's protection doesn't stop them. Daredevil then Tributes the boss as part of its own summon, which starts no chain, and destroys both Set cards. Drosophyllum Hydra Tributes the second monster. Starting hand: Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio + Predaplant Byblisp. Extra Deck: Predaplant Ambulomelides and Predaplant Daredevil. Watch for Ash Blossom on Scorpio and on the three adds, and for Nibiru once Daredevil, your fifth summon, is on the field. A monster that is unaffected by card effects can't get a Predator Counter at all.

comboData.title: Skyfall Shield: Ash-Proof Raviel Opener (Effect 1)
comboData.description: Going first. Starting hand: Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Lord of Phantasms, Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder and Sacred Beasts Skyfall. Your opponent chains Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring to Raviel's reveal effect, and Skyfall's first effect negates it. The line ends on Infinity Raviel with Martyrs to Tribute for its board wipe on your opponent's turn, plus the 2 cards Fallen Paradise draws.

cards.name: Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Lord of Phantasms
Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder
Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts

steps.text: Activate effect: reveal Infinity of the Sacred Beasts - Raviel, Lord of Phantasms in your hand. It adds 1 "Sacred Beast" monster from your Deck to your hand, then you discard 1 card.

Your opponent chains Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring. Chain Sacred Beasts Skyfall from your hand as Chain Link 3 and choose its first effect: they activated a card in response to your "Sacred Beast" monster's effect. A Quick-Play Spell can be activated from the hand during your own turn.
Skyfall resolves first and negates Ash Blossom's effect. Ash Blossom is still in their GY with its once-per-turn used, so it can't come back for Martyr later. Skyfall goes to the GY.
Raviel's effect resolves: add Martyr of the Sacred Beasts from your Deck to your hand.

Then discard 1 card: Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon. Keep Raviel, because Thunderclap needs a Level 10 "Sacred Beast" monster in your hand to reveal. With Hamon in the GY, Martyr's End Phase effect is live too.
Normal Summon Martyr of the Sacred Beasts.
Activate effect: Martyr of the Sacred Beasts was Normal Summoned. Place 1 "Sacred Beast" Continuous Spell from your Deck face-up on your field.
Sacred Beasts Thunderclap is placed face-up from your Deck. Placing a card doesn't add, summon or send it, so Ash Blossom couldn't have stopped this step anyway.
Activate effect: Sacred Beasts Thunderclap (your Main Phase). Place 2 more copies from your Deck face-up on your field.
The second Thunderclap is placed face-up.
The third Thunderclap is placed face-up.
Then reveal Infinity Raviel in your hand and place Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts from your Deck face-up in your Field Zone.
Activate effect: Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts (1st of up to 3 uses this turn). Send 3 other cards of the same type from your field to the GY: the three Thunderclaps.
Send the first Thunderclap to the GY.
Send the second Thunderclap to the GY.
Send the third Thunderclap to the GY. During your opponent's End Phase, one Thunderclap in your GY can add itself to your hand.

Then Special Summon Infinity Raviel from your hand in Attack Position. Fallen Paradise is a "Sacred Beast" card, so Raviel's summoning condition is met, and Raviel is unaffected by your opponent's activated Spell/Trap effects.
Activate effect: Fallen Paradise. You control a "Sacred Beast" monster whose original Level is 10, so draw 2 cards.
Activate effect: Martyr of the Sacred Beasts. You control another "Sacred Beast" monster (Raviel), so Special Summon 2 Martyrs from your Deck. Ash Blossom was already used this turn.
Special Summon the second Martyr from your Deck.
Special Summon the third Martyr from your Deck.

End board: Infinity Raviel (4000 ATK) and three Martyrs under Fallen Paradise. On your opponent's turn, Raviel's Quick Effect Tributes 2 Martyrs (they are "Sacred Beast" monsters) to destroy every monster they control, and gains 1000 ATK for each one. In their End Phase, 1 Martyr returns to your hand because Calamity Hamon is in your GY.

When the initial Normal Summon of Tearlaments Reinoheart is met with the opponent's Herald of Orange Light, Tearlaments Havnis immediately triggers from the hand. The resulting mills hit Tearlaments Merrli and Tearlaments Sulliek, netting a search for Tearlaments Scheiren and initiating a Fusion Summon into Tearlaments Kitkallos, which safely extends the board into Tearlaments Rulkallos. Heads-up: this line uses Tearlaments Kitkallos and Agido the Ancient Sentinel, which are Forbidden in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026), so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

comboData.title: Cartoon Shade: Toon Bookmark Going-Second Bounce
comboData.description: Two cards, going second into a board with a face-up Extra Deck monster. Extra Deck monsters can't be Normal Summoned, and Cartoon Shade's condition checks both sides of the field, so your opponent's monster lets Shade come out. Shade adds Toon Dark Magician Girl before Toon Kingdom is activated, so Kingdom's banish can't take her. Tributing Shade for her bounces 2 cards, and she attacks directly the same turn. Starting hand: Toon Bookmark, Cartoon Shade.

steps.text: Activate Toon Bookmark.
Add Toon Kingdom from your Deck to your hand. Its text names Toon World, so Bookmark can add it. Hold it for now.
Toon Bookmark goes to the GY. From there it can take the hit if Toon Kingdom would be destroyed by a card effect.
Special Summon Cartoon Shade from your hand. Your opponent's Extra Deck monster is face-up and can't be Normal Summoned, and Shade's condition checks the whole field.
Activate effect: Cartoon Shade was Special Summoned.
Add Toon Dark Magician Girl from your Deck to your hand. Adding her before Toon Kingdom is activated keeps her out of the 3 cards Kingdom banishes.
Activate Toon Kingdom. When it's activated, the top 3 cards of your Deck are banished face-down. In the Field Zone its name becomes Toon World.
Tribute Cartoon Shade for Toon Dark Magician Girl's summon. Her summon doesn't start a chain.
Special Summon Toon Dark Magician Girl from your hand. Toon Kingdom stops your opponent from targeting her.

Activate effect: Cartoon Shade was Tributed from the field. Toon Dark Magician Girl has 2000 ATK, so target 2 of your opponent's cards, for example their Extra Deck monster and a Set card, and return them. An Extra Deck monster goes back to the Extra Deck. Nothing is destroyed, so destruction immunity and 'if destroyed' effects don't help them.

Battle Phase: Toon Dark Magician Girl has no 'cannot attack the turn it's summoned' clause. Your opponent controls no Toon monster, so she attacks directly for 2000. Your Normal Summon is still unused.

comboData.description: Going first with two Beyond the Brave cards. Warchief of Atlantis finds Advent of Atlantis, Advent places Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon, and Warchief comes back because Advent is named "Umi" on the field. Siren Vortex of Atlantis and Advent's Graveyard search bring out Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus. Rage then brings Levia-Dragoon back from the Graveyard, so both of their Quick Effects are ready for your opponent's turn. Starting hand: Warchief of Atlantis + Siren Vortex of Atlantis.

comboData.title: Classic Meets Atlantis: Advent + Kairyu-Shin Lock With a Spare "Umi"
comboData.description: Two cards that join the old lock to the new engine. Advent of Atlantis can place A Legendary Ocean, because A Legendary Ocean is always treated as "Umi", even in the Deck. That lets Ocean Dragon Lord - Kairyu-Shin be Normal Summoned without a Tribute, and Advent is a second "Umi" that keeps Kairyu-Shin's lock on if the Field Spell is removed. Kairyu-Shin adds Kairyu-Shin's Dark Reef. On your opponent's turn, Dark Reef sends Advent to the GY, which adds a Level 7 Sea Serpent, and brings Electric Jellyfish and Fisherman of Legend out of the Deck. Starting hand: Advent of Atlantis + Ocean Dragon Lord - Kairyu-Shin.

steps.text: Activate Advent of Atlantis (Continuous Spell). While it's face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone, its name is "Umi".

Activate effect: Advent of Atlantis. It places 1 Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon or 1 "Umi" from your Deck face-up in your Field Zone. A Legendary Ocean is always treated as "Umi", even in the Deck, so it qualifies.
Place A Legendary Ocean face-up in your Field Zone. WATER monsters in both hands and on both fields are now 1 Level lower and gain 200 ATK/DEF on the field.

Normal Summon Ocean Dragon Lord - Kairyu-Shin without a Tribute: A Legendary Ocean makes it Level 4 in your hand. Atlantis would only do that once a monster that mentions Atlantis is already on the field.
Activate effect: Ocean Dragon Lord - Kairyu-Shin. It adds 1 "Umi", 1 "Kairyu-Shin" Spell/Trap or 1 "Sea Stealth" Spell/Trap from your Deck.
Add Kairyu-Shin's Dark Reef to your hand.

Set Kairyu-Shin's Dark Reef and end your turn. The lock is on: with "Umi" on the field, each player can control only 1 face-up non-WATER monster. A Legendary Ocean and Advent are both "Umi", so removing the Field Spell alone doesn't switch the lock off.
Once they have a monster on the field, flip and activate Kairyu-Shin's Dark Reef.
Send Advent of Atlantis to the GY as the cost: it's a face-up "Umi" you control. A Legendary Ocean stays, so the lock stays on.
Dark Reef resolves. Special Summon Electric Jellyfish from your Deck in Defense Position; it mentions "Umi".
Special Summon Fisherman of Legend from your Deck in Defense Position; it mentions "Umi" too and has a different name. Until the end of your next turn you can only Special Summon WATER monsters.
Kairyu-Shin's Dark Reef goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Fisherman of Legend (when it's summoned). Target 1 monster your opponent controls and destroy it. In the End Phase, Fisherman goes back to your hand.
Activate effect: Advent of Atlantis in the GY, chained with Fisherman. It was sent there as Dark Reef's cost, so it adds 1 Level 7 Sea Serpent monster from your Deck.
Add Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus to your hand. Next turn it can bring itself out, because you control "Umi".

End Phase: Fisherman of Legend returns to your hand. From there it's a hand trap: when your opponent activates a monster effect on the field or attacks while "Umi" is on the field, it comes out of your hand and destroys a monster again.

End of the line: Kairyu-Shin keeps the lock on, Electric Jellyfish can negate a monster effect or a Spell while "Umi" is on the field, Fisherman of Legend waits in your hand, and Levia-Dragon of Atlantis is ready for your turn. Your next Advent can place Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon; the new Field Spell sends A Legendary Ocean to the GY, and the Atlantis monsters keep "Umi" on the field.

When the opponent destroys Wasteland by battle, her effect triggers.
Special Summon a key EARTH Warrior from Deck, such as another Wasteland, Exiled Force for removal, or an engine starter like U.A. Midfielder.
The first Wasteland is now in the GY.
During your Main Phase, activate Rookie Warrior Lady 's effect in the GY.
Banish her to add Warrior Lady of the Wasteland from your GY back to your hand.
You are now ready to set Wasteland and repeat the entire loop.

Discard it to activate its effect, adding Bonding - DHO from your Deck to your hand.
Use a Dinosaur starter, such as Souleating Oviraptor, to send Hydrogeddon and Oxygeddon from your Deck to the Graveyard.

Set Bonding - DHO.
activate it.
